g.title: Workflow
g.text: Rules read and decide · Claude helps with judgment · People make the clinical calls

g.title: read
g.text: Rules read BI-RADS, exam date, breast
(each breast on its own when assessed separately)

g.title: checks
g.text: One category per breast; valid date;

g.title: timing
g.text: Urgent: text day 0, portal day 2, call day 4.
No response after 3 attempts: navigator day 5.
Replies but unbooked: check-in every 3 days.
Unbooked: biopsy day 7; diagnostic day 30 after exam.
BI-RADS 3: reminders start 1 month before due;
text, portal +7 days, call +14 days; further reminders
at due −7, due, due +14 days if unanswered.

g.title: footer
g.text: Synthetic demo · Not for clinical use
No real messages, bookings or EHR writes. No-show / rebooking flows are future work.
60-day resolution is reported for the abnormal-result cohort, not a separate escalation trigger.
